mentions.name: Survival-to-roguelike game mod
mentions.description: This planned mod turns a survival game into a roguelike in the style of the Hades 2 challenge runs, letting the player start a session in a chosen biome without first grinding through progression on a new character.
mentions.problem: Playing a session in a specific biome otherwise requires doing all the grind first to get there on a new character.
mentions.source_excerpt: next idea is for when thats done is to make a mod that turns a survival game into a roguelike - in the style of the hades 2 challenge runs, so i can play a session of the game in a certain biome without having to do all the grind first to get there on a new character.
